notes:
JAVASCRIPT-RENDERED SITE: This site loads all business listings dynamically via JavaScript/AJAX. The static HTML only contains a loading spinner and page structure. To scrape this site, you will need:

1. BROWSER AUTOMATION: Use Playwright, Puppeteer, or Selenium to render JavaScript
2. WAIT FOR CONTENT: Wait for the loading spinner (#jSplash) to disappear and listings to appear
3. ALTERNATIVE URLS: The site has multiple listing pages:
   - https://www.svbusinessbroker.com/business-listing/
   - https://www.svbusinessbroker.com/buy-a-business (also found working)
4. SITE STRUCTURE: WordPress site with Visual Composer
5. LOCATION: Maryland, Washington DC, Vienna VA, Northern Virginia area
6. CONTACT: info@svbusinessbroker.com, (301) 956-6004, (301) 675-1292

NEXT STEPS FOR SCRAPING:
- Use Playwright/Puppeteer to load the page
- Wait for content to appear (wait for network idle or specific selectors)
- Inspect the rendered DOM to identify listing container and field selectors
- May also check browser Network tab for API endpoints that could be called directly
